Columbia Southern’s transfer rules

  • Up to 90 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 120-credit degree.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Columbia Southern.

Source: Columbia Southern University 2026–2028 catalog: transfer credit limits, tuition and fees, graduation requirements (PDF pp. 25, 28, 200)

Pace used in this example

  • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
  • 3–6 credits per university 9-week term is a planning assumption.
  • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
  • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
  • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

What this range leaves out

  • Uses the $278 standard undergraduate rate. CSU Learning Partner rates ($250.20) and the $250 active-duty Tuition Assistance rate, which also waives the technology fee, are not applied.
  • The $35 per-course technology fee is spread as $11.67 per credit (most courses are 3 credits), about 1 cent over per course.
  • Books, the 2.75% card payment fee and the drop registration fee are not included.
  • A term is 9 weeks (4 terms and 36 weeks of instruction a year), modeled as 2 months; 3–6 credits per term is a planning assumption (6 is a full-time load, 9 the maximum).
  • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
  • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
  • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
  • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
  • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
  • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
  • Sophia uses the lowest published mix of monthly, four-month and annual memberships for the assumed study time. Prepaid plans require the upfront payment; promotions and tax are excluded.
  • 12 proposed outside units retain the eligibility conditions shown on their course rows.

Questions

Does Sophia Introduction to Web Development transfer to Columbia Southern University?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Introduction to Web Development for Open Electives (24 credit hours required when a concentration is completed) (3 semester credits). The match does not come from Columbia Southern, so ask Columbia Southern to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Personal Finance transfer to Columbia Southern University?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Personal Finance for Open Electives (24 credit hours required when a concentration is completed) (3 semester credits). The match does not come from Columbia Southern, so ask Columbia Southern to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Introduction to Relational Databases transfer to Columbia Southern University?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Introduction to Relational Databases for Open Electives (24 credit hours required when a concentration is completed) (3 semester credits). The match does not come from Columbia Southern, so ask Columbia Southern to confirm it before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Columbia Southern University’s B.S. Psychology?

Columbia Southern’s published limit for this 120-credit degree is 90 semester credits from other sources. At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Columbia Southern. This plan proposes 12 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Columbia Southern University?

In this plan, 108 semester credits are taken at Columbia Southern, including PSY 4320 Psychology Capstone. Columbia Southern requires at least 30 semester credits at Columbia Southern.

Can I choose my own courses in this plan?

Yes. 72 semester credits are open choices, such as Concentration (optional) or 12 additional open elective credits, Program Electives (select 4 courses from the listed options) and Open Electives (24 credit hours required when a concentration is completed). You pick a course Columbia Southern allows, then ask Columbia Southern to confirm it counts.

How much does this plan cost?

The planning estimate is $31,483 to $31,582 before aid. It covers tuition, listed fees and the outside courses in this plan. It is not a complete cost of attendance.

Has Columbia Southern University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Columbia Southern’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Ask the school: what is the most ACE- or NCCRS-recommended credit you accept toward this degree? Pick a course for 24 open course choices in this plan, then ask the school to confirm they count. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Columbia Southern’s decisions.
